scenario: AITA for getting mad at my bf for always walking in front of me? | Everytime my boyfriend and I are walking somewhere, he tends to walk much faster than me. I’m actually a pretty fast walker myself when alone, but when going out with him, either I’m in heels half the time so it’s harder to walk super fast, or even in flats, sometimes I just want to walk alongside him and hold hands and have a conversation. It’s hard to hear him or I’m struggling to keep up. I’ve brought it up to him multiple times but he says he just has longer strides (he’s maybe 6” taller than me) and can’t help it. AITA and he really can’t help it?
